resources.string: Files encrypted on this device. They stay out of the browser, search, the widgets and the share sheet until you unlock.
FOLD needs your fingerprint to use the vault key.
The light ground means you are inside the vault. It locks itself after five minutes, or when you leave the app.

When a file moves into the vault, FOLD encrypts it, checks the copy reads back, then deletes the original. On flash storage that deletion is best-effort — the phone may keep the old blocks readable for a while. FOLD cannot guarantee erasure and does not claim to.
The vault needs a screen lock. Android will not create a key that requires authentication on a device with nothing to authenticate against. Set a PIN, pattern or password and come back.

The vault key was invalidated, most likely because a new fingerprint was added. The encrypted files can no longer be opened, and trying again will not help. This is the trade that stops someone who can enrol a finger from inheriting the vault.
